name: Alberto García Illera
biography: is a 24 year old passionate about hacking and especially for social engineering. He studied mathematics and computer systems in Spain. He has worked several years as a professional pentester. He has spoken in several seminars teaching hacking techniques to help big companies like Microsoft, the Spanish government or the Spanish Police's Cyberterrorism department. He is currently making a study about cryptographic hash functions applied to IT security.
